description: The autonomy.pinned happy path (S56 T6, AL8): what a loop was pinned with, and whether that authority is still live. Each pinned grant carries its LIVE status — the closed trio active|revoked|expired — with the SAME sentences the decision site speaks when it denies, so what the panel shows and what the loop is told are one truth (AL17). The per-action verdicts are built exactly as the decision site builds them (zero seams, pr 0). A loop with no pin row answers {pinned:false, statement}, not an error; an unknown loop is a refusal.
